x-contract.tenant: platform public projection; no client tenant selection

get.summary: Read a published public content projection

x-contract.versioning: optional version pin; never silently falls forward or backward
x-contract.fieldFiltering: PUBLIC_V1 allow-list; answerRuleVersion, draft payload, reviewer actors and license evidence are excluded

x-contract.projection: public site projection assembled from published read models
x-contract.fieldFiltering: public courses, published price cards, download channels, announcements and compliance notices only
x-contract.forbiddenDependency: official-site must not call authenticated learner, admin or IAM APIs

x-contract.authorization: verified principal, phase and content rights; resource owner is not client supplied

get.summary: Read a version-pinned learner content projection

x-contract.authorization: service-side PEP evaluates phase, rights, entitlement and device/offline state
x-contract.fieldFiltering: LEARNER_V1 allow-list; answer rules remain assessment-service internal

get.summary: List admin content state and review/publication status

x-contract.fieldFiltering: admin role-specific fields; no direct database projection or cross-service write

x-contract.commandBoundary: admin sends command; it never writes content tables
x-contract.authorization: content-editor/reviewer-l1/reviewer-l2/release-operator scopes plus ABAC rights and stage
x-contract.dualReview: REVIEW_FIRST and REVIEW_FINAL require distinct verified actors; author cannot review own version

x-idempotency.replayBehavior: same actor, target and request hash returns original command result

202.description: Command accepted for content-service application and Outbox publication

get.summary: Read admin content state and review/publication status

x-contract.fieldFiltering: admin role-specific fields; no direct database projection or cross-service write

get.summary: Read a public projection through workload identity

x-contract.fieldFiltering: same PUBLIC_V1 allow-list; workload identity does not unlock private content

get.summary: Read a versioned assessment content snapshot

x-contract.fieldFiltering: opaque answer-rule version and scoring references only; no learner-facing answer rule body

licenseCode.description: Admin-only reference; public projections expose only a rights status.

stimulusRef.description: Opaque reference to a content stimulus; answer material is not carried here.

definition.description: Service-owned structured definition. Public projection is generated by an allow-list, never by copying this object.

answerRuleVersion.description: Opaque internal version used only by assessment-service; never emitted in public or learner projections.

B9ContentCommandRequest.description: 命令只表达意图和资源版本；actor、tenant、owner、role、permission、reviewer 和版权事实均由服务端从已验证上下文与内容记录派生。

outboxEventId.description: Content-service Outbox event identity; publication is at-least-once and consumers deduplicate.

B9LearnerContentProjection.x-field-filtering: LEARNER_V1 is PUBLIC_V1 plus server-computed access flags; no content answer rules

authorSubject.description: 仅向具备审核权限的后台投影提供；服务端仍必须独立拒绝作者自审。

answerRuleVersion.description: Opaque version identifier only; no answer rule body is returned.
